customManagers.description: Track GitHub Actions runner versions declared in a build matrix (`strategy.matrix...runner: <os>-<version>`). The built-in github-runners manager only reads literal `runs-on:` values, so matrix-driven runners go unpinned and unupdated. Matches ubuntu/macos/windows. Any suffix (`-arm`, `-large`, `-xlarge`) is part of currentValue so docker versioning only offers releases with the same suffix, e.g. macos-14-large -> macos-15-large, never macos-26-large.
